records.jp: 結局私は、何が正解なのか分からないまま<CR>今日を迎えてしまいました
records.en_original: In the end, I've come this far and still don't have an answer.
records.en_auxiliary: In the end, I've come this far and still don't have an answer.
records.en: In the end, today arrived before I ever found<CR>the right answer.

records.jp: 正解っていうのは？
records.en_original: Answer for what?
records.en_auxiliary: Answer for what?
records.en: The right answer to what?

records.jp: 想いとは何なのか。<CR>私の中の胸のモヤモヤは何なのか
records.en_original: What are emotions? What is this fuzzy sensation in my heart.
records.en_auxiliary: What are emotions? What is this fuzzy sensation in my heart.
records.en: What feelings are.<CR>What this uneasiness in my chest is.

records.jp: 私は許されてよいのか。<CR>そして……新しい世界に、私は必要なのか
records.en_original: Can I be forgiven? And...will the new world have any need for me?
records.en_auxiliary: Can I be forgiven? And...will the new world have any need for me?
records.en: Whether I deserve forgiveness.<CR>And...whether the new world needs me.

records.jp: そうだなぁ……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: きっと、詩さんじゃなくても<CR>答えを出すのは難しいよ
records.en_original: I think that would hard for anyone to answer, not just you.
records.en_auxiliary: I think that would hard for anyone to answer, not just you.
records.en: I'm sure that would be hard for anyone to answer,<CR>not only you, Uta-san.

records.jp: ……そうなんでしょうか
records.en_original: Is that so...?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that so...?
records.en: Is that so...?

records.jp: この世界に必要ない人間はいない……<CR>みたいな、きれいごとを言うのは簡単だけどさ
records.en_original: I think there's a place for everyone in this world. ...Though I guess that's easy for me to say.
records.en_auxiliary: I think there's a place for everyone in this world. ...Though I guess that's easy for me to say.
records.en: It's easy to offer a pretty platitude like,<CR>'No one is unnecessary in this world,' but...

records.jp: 実際のところ、詩さんにとって<CR>元の世界は生きにくい場所だったんだと思う
records.en_original: I think the old world was a very hard place to live in for you.
records.en_auxiliary: I think the old world was a very hard place to live in for you.
records.en: In reality, I think the old world<CR>was a difficult place for you to live, Uta-san.

records.jp: その気持ちを全部理解することはできなくても……<CR>私にも、ちょっとくらいは分かる
records.en_original: Even if I can't totally understand, I think I can at least sympathize.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if I can't totally understand, I think I can at least sympathize.
records.en: Even if I can't understand all of those feelings...<CR>I can understand a little.

records.jp: ――でも、ダメ。<CR>新しい世界は、みんなで行くんだ
records.en_original: But that won't do. We're all going to the new world together.
records.en_auxiliary: But that won't do. We're all going to the new world together.
records.en: But that won't do.<CR>We're all going to the new world together.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: ダメだよ、一人だけいないなんて。<CR>全員で行くんだ。誰も欠けちゃいけない
records.en_original: I won't let anyone be left behind. Everyone is going together.
records.en_auxiliary: I won't let anyone be left behind. Everyone is going together.
records.en: I won't let anyone be left behind.<CR>Everyone is going together.

records.jp: 元の世界であったことが、<CR>突然すべてなかったことになるとは思えない
records.en_original: Nothing will change the things that happened in the old world.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing will change the things that happened in the old world.
records.en: I don't think everything that happened in the old world<CR>will suddenly cease to have happened.

records.jp: それでも――<CR>それでも、私は変われると思いますか？
records.en_original: But... Do you think that I can still change?
records.en_auxiliary: But... Do you think that I can still change?
records.en: Even so—<CR>do you think I can change?

records.jp: 決めるのは私じゃない。詩さんだよ
records.en_original: That's something you have to decide yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: That's something you have to decide yourself.
records.en: That's not for me to decide. It's up to you, Uta-san.

records.jp: 何を選んで、どういう道を進むか。<CR>すべては新たな世界での詩さん次第だから
records.en_original: You decide the path you'll take in the new world. How you'll live.
records.en_auxiliary: You decide the path you'll take in the new world. How you'll live.
records.en: What you choose and what path you follow—<CR>all of it depends on the Uta-san in the new world.

records.jp: 私、次第……
records.en_original: How I'll live...
records.en_auxiliary: How I'll live...
records.en: Depends on me...

records.jp: 不安？
records.en_original: Are you worried?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you worried?
records.en: Are you worried?

records.jp: …………はい、少し
records.en_original: A little...yes.
records.en_auxiliary: A little...yes.
records.en: ...Yes. A little.

records.jp: ならこうしよう
records.en_original: Then this is what we'll do.
records.en_auxiliary: Then this is what we'll do.
records.en: Then let's do this.

records.jp: もしまた何か失敗したときは、<CR>みんなと一緒に、私が何度でも止める
records.en_original: If you fail, the others and I will come and stop you as many times as we have to.
records.en_auxiliary: If you fail, the others and I will come and stop you as many times as we have to.
records.en: If you make another mistake, I'll stop you as many times as it takes,<CR>together with everyone.

records.jp: だから、安心して失敗して！！<CR>あ、でもあんまり人に迷惑かけちゃダメだよ？
records.en_original: So you don't need to be afraid od failure! Just try not to cause too much trouble, okay?
records.en_auxiliary: So you don't need to be afraid od failure! Just try not to cause too much trouble, okay?
records.en: So make mistakes without fear!!<CR>Ah, but don't cause too much trouble for people, okay?

records.jp: ふふっ
records.en_original: Hehe.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe.
records.en: Hehe.

records.jp: ……なんですか、それ
records.en_original: What kind of plan is that?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of plan is that?
records.en: What is that supposed to be?

records.jp: えー？　そんなに変かな？
records.en_original: Huh? Did I say something weird?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Did I say something weird?
records.en: Huh? Is it really that strange?

records.jp: ……いいえ、そんなことはないです
records.en_original: Nt at all.
records.en_auxiliary: Nt at all.
records.en: No, not at all.

records.jp: ……分かりました。<CR>胸に留めておきます。星崎さんの言葉
records.en_original: I understand. I will keep your words close to my heart, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I understand. I will keep your words close to my heart, Ao.
records.en: I understand.<CR>I'll keep your words in my heart, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: ん？　どうしたの、詩さん
records.en_original: Hmm? What's wrong, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm? What's wrong, Uta?
records.en: Hmm? What's wrong, Uta-san?

records.jp: …………全身が痒くなってきました。<CR>まさか、私がこんなことを言うなんて
records.en_original: How embarrassing... I never thought I'd say something like that.
records.en_auxiliary: How embarrassing... I never thought I'd say something like that.
records.en: My whole body has started itching.<CR>I cannot believe I would say such a thing.

records.jp: ふふっ。詩さんが変わり始めたって証拠だよ！
records.en_original: Hehe. It's proof that you're starting to change!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. It's proof that you're starting to change!
records.en: Hehe. That's proof you're starting to change, Uta-san!

records.jp: ……そうなのでしょうか
records.en_original: Do you think so...?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you think so...?
records.en: Is that so...?

records.jp: ――いえ、そうだといいですね
records.en_original: I hope you're right.
records.en_auxiliary: I hope you're right.
records.en: No—I hope it is.

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: こんな私でも、変われるかもしれない……
records.en_original: I don't know if it's possible for someone like me to change...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if it's possible for someone like me to change...
records.en: Perhaps even someone like me can change...

records.jp: なら、せめて祈るとしましょう
records.en_original: But I'll never stop hoping.
records.en_auxiliary: But I'll never stop hoping.
records.en: Then at the very least, I shall pray.

records.jp: 願わくば、次の世界では――<CR>今とは違う、新しい私になれますように
records.en_original: That in the new world I'll be a new me.
records.en_auxiliary: That in the new world I'll be a new me.
records.en: May I become a new me, different from the one I am now,<CR>in the next world—

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you.
records.en: I want to see you.

records.jp: 星崎さんに会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you, Ao.
records.en: I want to see you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 私は、奇跡を信じる
records.en_original: I believe in miracles.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in miracles.
records.en: I believe in miracles.
